title and abstract.summary: The study examined the effects of different urban land-use types on wild bees, grouping the bees according to their traits (e.g., size, nesting and pollen-collecting behaviour) to account for species-specific requirements, rather than focusing on individual species.

methods.summary: The study measured the presence and abundance of various bees, including some identified to the genus level, and also recorded vegetation characteristics such as flowering plant species richness and cover at the study sites.
